title: Beyoncé Celebrates Birthday with B’Day Deluxe Edition
seoTitle: Beyoncé Celebrates Birthday with B’Day Deluxe Edition
subtitle: Remastered Album Features Unreleased Tracks, Spanish Versions, and New 4K Visuals
excerpt: On her birthday, Beyoncé releases the deluxe edition of the album B’Day, celebrating 20 years with unreleased music, Spanish collaborations, and remastered videos.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
To mark her birthday, Beyoncé today released the deluxe edition of the album B’Day, celebrating 20 years of the work that solidified her as a complete artist. The re-release features unreleased tracks, Spanish versions, and fully remastered videos in 4K.

What the B’Day Deluxe Edition Includes

The new version features the original remastered album, plus "Morning Dew (Donk)" and never-before-released tracks such as "Can I Watch You" with Pharrell, "My First Time," "Lost Yo Mind," "Creole," and "Back Up." There are also new sequences and a commemorative booklet.

New Spanish Recordings

Two new Spanish tracks arrive on the album: "Cuerpo Tumbao (Get Me Bodied)" with Colombian artist Maluma, which samples Celia Cruz's "La Negra Tiene Tumbao," and "Irreemplazable (Como La Flor)" featuring the voice of Selena Quintanilla, authorized by her estate. Both celebrate Beyoncé's admiration for Latin culture.

4K Remastered Videos

The original music videos, shot on 35mm film, have been recolored and finalized in 4K, including "Déjà Vu" with Jay-Z and the "Déjà Vu" visual released simultaneously. The visual work reinforces the album's concept as the artist's first visual album.

Physical and Digital Formats

The deluxe edition is available on 180g vinyl (standard 2 LP and deluxe 4 LP in Bayou Blue), CD, and a complete digital version, which includes the Spanish tracks and digital bonuses.

Cultural Impact of the Reissue

By revisiting B’Day, Beyoncé reinforces themes of confidence, liberation, and strength that remain relevant. Collaborations with Maluma and Selena expand the dialogue between R&B and Latin music, while the video remastering offers a renewed visual experience for fans of all generations.

With information from PR Newswire, Variety, Just Jared.
